settings.text: Collagen is the main component of connective tissue and is the most abundant protein in the human body.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It makes up approximately 30% of the who
settings.text: It makes up approximately 30% of the whole body and 70% to 80% of the skin's protein content. As a result, you'd be hard-pressed to find a body part that doesn't contain collagen. It's in your skin, hair, bones, cartilage, digestive system, and more.
